name: How long does a garage interior remodel take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage interior remodel take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage interior remodel generally ranges from one to three weeks depending on project scope. Basic drywall installation, taping, and painting can take about five to seven business days, allowing proper drying time between mud coats and paint layers. If your remodel involves framing new partition walls, building custom storage, or coordinating rough-in electrical work for heavy tools or heating, project duration extends toward two to three weeks. Clear site access and having all items cleared out of the garage beforehand helps keep the schedule on track.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most garage interior upgrades take one to three weeks, depending on whether you need simple drywall and paint or extensive framing, electrical rough-ins, and custom carpentry.
